text:
maria.g: Quick sync — I'm prepping the mariner-v2 onboarding PR (https://git.redwood/inference/pulls/4321). Need a final sign-off on weights mirror URIs, tokenizer sanity, config lint, and the canary+region plan. Can folks ack and call out blockers?

alex.k: I pushed the mirrored tarball to gs://redwood-model-mirror/mariner/v2/mariner-v2-20260315.tar.gz and updated the model config to use mirror_uri. SHA256 verified.

maria.g: Can you paste the sha and the validate command? I want to run the config linter locally before merging.

alex.k: SHA: `3a7f2c9b8d1e4a6b7c4f2e8d6b9c1a2e3f4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8`
Run: ```bash
./devtools/validate_model_config.py --model mariner-v2 --config manifests/mariner-v2.yaml --weights-uri gs://redwood-model-mirror/mariner/v2/mariner-v2-20260315.tar.gz
```
Should return `OK` and a matching sha.

jin.z: Quick heads-up on tokenizer — mariner-v2's BPE split differs on ZWJ+emoji sequences. In internal eval some 2-char emoji sequences produce an extra <unk> token, which shifts KV cache offsets for long-chat workloads. Repro snippet: ```text
input: "hey 👩‍🔬 let's test"
tokens: ["hey"," ","👩","�","\"...\""]
```
Workaround for now: enable `preserve_unicode_combining: true` in tokenizer config to avoid splitting. I'll open a tiny tokenizer patch and a test.

maria.g: Good catch. Can we gate on a tokenizer regression test passing in CI before canary?

jin.z: Yep, added unit test in the PR. CI job `tokenizer-regressions` runs on the PR.

deploy-bot: CI update — mariner-v2 PR #4321: lint ✅, unit-tests ✅, tokenizer-regressions ⏳ (running), smoke-canary ⏳

sam.t: On region enablement: recommended rollout order — us-west -> eu-west -> ap-southeast. Start a 1% traffic canary in us-west for 30m, then increase to 10% for 2h if no errors. If errors spike, automatic fallback to mariner-v2-compat (quantized variant).

lee.p: Request: pin the catalog entry to `mariner:v2-20260315` and also add a `fallback_variant: mariner-small-v1` in the manifest for the first 48h. That reduces risk during cold-starts.

maria.g: Sounds good. One more: config validator flagged `max_batch_tokens` unset — defaulting to 1024 may be too small for some customers. Recommend setting it explicitly to 2048 in manifests/mariner-v2.yaml.

alex.k: Updated the YAML to set `max_batch_tokens: 2048` and added the fallback_variant as requested. Pushed new manifest commit.

deploy-bot: CI update — tokenizer-regressions ✅, smoke-canary job started in us-west-2 (canary id cny-789).

jin.z: I ran a local long-chat loop against the canary image with `preserve_unicode_combining: true` and KV cache offsets look stable. No token drift observed across 1k steps.

sam.t: I'll schedule the regional enable job: starting us-west canary at 10:30 PT, monitor latency and 5xxs. If stable after 2h, I'll open a ticket to enable eu-west next day.

maria.g: OK — final checklist before merge: 1) weights SHA ok (alex) 2) config linter ok (alex) 3) tokenizer regression pass (jin) 4) smoke canary running and initial health green (deploy-bot) 5) fallback variant and pin set (lee) 6) region plan scheduled (sam). If all green by EOD I'll merge the PR and kick the rollout.

lee.p: ACK, I'll keep standby for quick fallback changes.

alex.k: All green from my side. SHA verified, manifest updated.

deploy-bot: Canary health update (cny-789): startup ✅, gRPC handshake ✅, 99th p50 latency 42ms, error-rate 0.03% — within SLO.

maria.g: Great — merging once canary hits 2h stable metric threshold. Thanks everyone. :tada:
